definition: Gabriella Sanniti di Baja (born 29 January 1950) is a retired Italian computer scientist specializing in pattern recognition, including digital geometry and skeletonization.
details: Gabriella Sanniti di Baja (born 29 January 1950) is a retired Italian computer scientist specializing in pattern recognition, including digital geometry and skeletonization.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Gabriella Sanniti di Baja.
